title: Fix the Array Bounds Loop
description: The program should print every element of a 5-element array.
expectedBehavior: The program should print all five numbers: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50.
actualProblem: The loop condition i <= numbers.length allows i to reach 5, but valid indices for a 5-element array only go up to 4. Accessing numbers[5] throws an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
explanation: Array indices run from 0 to length - 1. Using < (strictly less than) instead of <= against .length ensures the loop stops exactly at the last valid index.
